lines.zh: 两对前肢一起动，走起来很别扭。
lines.en: Two pairs of forelimbs move together. My gait is wrong.
I have one pair of arms more than a rex.

lines.zh: 我的步子很沉，地面在响。
lines.en: My steps are heavy; the ground answers.

lines.zh: 我走得不协调，像被拼起来的。
lines.en: I walk unevenly, like something assembled.

lines.zh: 实验室的味道还留在我身上。
lines.en: The smell of the lab is still on me.
When I turn, trees snap.

lines.zh: 我的背上有两种骨头的痕迹。
lines.en: My back bears marks of two kinds of bone.
I walk toward the fence. It is too low.
My tail is heavy and drags.

lines.zh: 我走过水洼，水被震出去。
lines.en: I cross a puddle and the water jumps out.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己该算什么。
lines.en: I do not know what I am supposed to be.

lines.zh: 我走起来，像两种动物在争。
lines.en: My walk looks like two animals arguing.
My shoulders are wider than a doorway.

lines.zh: 我沿着围栏走，找薄弱处。
lines.en: I walk the fence looking for a weak point.
I stand with four foreclaws hanging.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很重，像两台机器。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy, like two machines.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的前肢，很久了。
lines.en: I look at my forelimbs a long while.
This body was put together.

lines.zh: 我身上有缝，缝里不长鳞。
lines.en: There are seams on me where no scales grow.

lines.zh: 我在听围墙外面的声音。
lines.en: I listen beyond the wall.

lines.zh: 我不属于任何一种恐龙。
lines.en: I belong to no species of dinosaur.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味吹到栅栏那边。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent past the fence.

lines.zh: 爪子插进土里，稳住身子。
lines.en: Claws dug into the soil to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我记得有管子插在我身上。
lines.en: I remember tubes in my body.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，牙长得很不整齐。
lines.en: I open my mouth; my teeth grew unevenly.

lines.zh: 我等一个能出去的机会。
lines.en: I wait for a chance to get out.
I lift a leg and another refuses.
I cannot roar properly. The sound is wrong.

lines.zh: 你看我，像看一件错的东西。
lines.en: You look at me like a mistake.

lines.zh: 我也不知道自己是什么。
lines.en: I do not know what I am either.
Do you have a key?
I count your legs. Two.
I have six, and they are not enough.

lines.zh: 你后退，是因为我的胳膊。
lines.en: You back away because of my arms.
I come to the fence and it creaks.
Do not stand by the gate.

lines.zh: 我认识你这个姿势，是来观察的。
lines.en: I know that stance. You came to observe.

lines.zh: 我在玻璃后面待过很久。
lines.en: I spent a long time behind glass.
Do you mean to open that door?

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我的骨缝上。
lines.en: That landed on a bone seam.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，四只前爪乱抓。
lines.en: I back two steps, four foreclaws flailing.

lines.zh: 我的身体不协调，疼也乱。
lines.en: My body is uncoordinated, so the pain is too.
Blood runs from the seam.
I cannot roar. I can only pant.

lines.zh: 这具身体会疼，这我知道。
lines.en: This body feels pain. I know that.
I look at the wound. It is unfamiliar.
A precise strike. A pity I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 两对前肢，基因拼出来的。
lines.en: Two pairs of forelimbs, spliced together.
The smell is wrong, so I turn my head away.
I have eaten stranger things.
You hold the meat high. Out of reach.

lines.zh: 这点分量塞不满我牙缝。
lines.en: That much would not fill the gaps in my teeth.
Put it on the ground and I will consider.
I smell medicine.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起实验室。
lines.en: This smell recalls the lab.
Take it away. I do not want it.
Bring your hand a little closer. Try.

lines.zh: 四只前肢，都是基因缝的。
lines.en: Four forelimbs, all stitched from genes.
Move; I can hardly walk straight myself.
That knock sent you far back.

lines.zh: 围栏被我们一起撞得响。
lines.en: The fence rings where we hit it.

lines.zh: 我比暴龙多一对手臂，走起来别扭。
lines.en: One more pair of arms than a rex; I walk awkwardly.
Again, and I press you with a forelimb.
I stand steadier than you.

lines.zh: 两对前肢，正好按住你的肩。
lines.en: Two pairs of forelimbs, just right for pinning your shoulders.

lines.zh: 我是被造出来的，没有同类。
lines.en: I was made. I have no kind.

lines.zh: 这种事，对我来说不成立。
lines.en: Such a thing does not apply to me.

lines.zh: 两种基因在我身体里吵。
lines.en: Two kinds of genes argue inside me.

lines.zh: 实验室里没有这种安排。
lines.en: The lab had no such arrangement.
Do not ask me. I have asked myself.

lines.zh: 我连自己算什么都说不清。
lines.en: I cannot even say what I am.
I only want to get out.
The world beyond the wall is bigger.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有别的恐龙。
lines.en: I hear other dinosaurs far off.

lines.zh: 我抓起一棵树，连根拔起。
lines.en: I take a tree, roots and all.

lines.zh: 这块肉太小，我一口就没了。
lines.en: This meat is one mouthful.
I hold it with two forelimbs at once.
It crushes in my claws.
This is bone, not stone.
I throw it into the corner.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，放下了，两对前肢都不太会拿。
lines.en: I sniffed it and set it down; four forelimbs are awkward.
There is a human smell on it.

lines.zh: 我这两对前肢，是拼出来的。
lines.en: These two pairs of arms were spliced in.

lines.zh: 我的四只前爪都收紧了。
lines.en: All four of my foreclaws tighten.
I smell the salt in your blood.
You are inside the fence.
My head lowers and aims at you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的味道很新。
lines.en: Your smell is very new.
I come toward you, gait uneven.
The gate is behind you.

lines.zh: 我的脊背拱起来，准备扑。
lines.en: My spine arches, ready to pounce.
I am excited. I cannot control it.
For this blow I need not think.
My growl makes the leaves tremble.

lines.zh: 我两对前肢，各有各的用法。
lines.en: My two pairs of forelimbs each have their use.

lines.zh: 我一步步跟着，地都在震。
lines.en: I follow step by step, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 你跑得比我快，但这里很窄。
lines.en: You are faster, but this place is narrow.
I block the gate.

lines.zh: 我的四只前爪一起抓地。
lines.en: All four forelimbs grip the ground.
You have gone behind the fence.
I knock down a stretch of fence.
I need no speed. I am large enough.

lines.zh: 我的两对前肢同时落地。
lines.en: Both pairs of my forelimbs hit the ground together.

lines.zh: 我的四只眼一直跟着你。
lines.en: My four eyes never leave you.
You are tiring. I can hear it.
Each circle, I tighten slightly.
My breath reaches your face.
For the last steps, I slow.
My claw comes down and the ground splits.
All four foreclaws rake at once.
My teeth are uneven, but deep.
This charge sends you flying.
I bite, then shake my head.
My two forelimbs pin you.

lines.zh: 我有两对前肢，不够用也够用。
lines.en: Two pairs of forelimbs; enough, or not.
That bent the fence itself.
My foreclaw pins your shoulder.
I roar, and the sound comes out wrong.

lines.zh: 我的身体不太协调，但很重。
lines.en: My body is awkward, but heavy.
Still standing. I did not expect that.
My tail sweeps the shrubs flat.
This blow is for whoever made me.
I rise out of the growth tank.

lines.zh: 两对前肢第一次同时动。
lines.en: Two pairs of forelimbs move together for the first time.
Glass everywhere.
My body is larger than the blueprint.

lines.zh: 第一口气，是药水的味道。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of chemicals.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己算哪一种。
lines.en: I do not know which kind I count as.
My bone seams creak.
Outside: trees, and a wall.
I look up. The sky is too high.
I remember tubes, and lights.

lines.zh: 我试着走了一步，很别扭。
lines.en: I try one step. It is awkward.
I head for the wall.
There are sounds beyond the wall.
I roar. The sound is wrong.

lines.zh: 我留在这世上的第一个印记，是脚印。
lines.en: My first mark on this world is a footprint.
Two pairs of forelimbs, one tail.
I walk toward the nearest sound.
I am Distortus.

lines.zh: 火在我皮上烧，两种皮都在烧。
lines.en: Fire burns my hide, both kinds of it.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸塌一段围栏。
lines.en: I fall from height and crush a stretch of fence.

lines.zh: 水灌进骨缝，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water fills my bone seams and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，四只爪子朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me, four claws up.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的肩缝里。
lines.en: Something lodges in my shoulder seam.

lines.zh: 咒力碰到拼接的地方，很痛。
lines.en: The curse hits where I am joined. It hurts.

lines.zh: 我饿得站不稳，两条腿在抖。
lines.en: Too hungry to stand; two legs tremble.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的身体，从我另一侧出去。
lines.en: Lightning enters one side and leaves the other.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，只有掉下去。
lines.en: No ground below, only falling.
